expectations.text: The dropdown includes a designed empty state (e.g. "no notifications yet") rather than rendering nothing or a blank list when there's no data
expectations.evidence: NotificationBell.tsx line 112-116: notifications.length === 0 renders a centered Bell icon + "Nothing yet — completed jobs will show up here."

expectations.text: The dropdown/menu uses shadow-based elevation (.nova-card pattern) consistent with the rest of the app
expectations.evidence: Line 106: className includes "nova-fade-in nova-card nova-scrollbar ... rounded-2xl".

expectations.text: Interactive elements (bell trigger, dropdown items) have visible focus states or aria attributes for keyboard/screen-reader accessibility
expectations.evidence: aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded={open} on the trigger, role="menu" on the dropdown; closes on outside-click/Escape per the summary.

expectations.text: No new hardcoded hex color values are introduced outside src/lib/design-tokens.ts or globals.css
expectations.evidence: No hex literals found in NotificationBell.tsx or the SiteHeader.tsx diff -- status colors use existing text-violet/text-coral utilities.

expectations.text: Reuses existing shared primitives/tokens rather than inventing one-off styling for the same job
expectations.evidence: Matches ProcessingView's existing done/failed color treatment (teal check / coral warning) and reuses the dashboard's job-fetching query pattern.
